catch_copy: Once you start, you can't stop! The addictively charming cat game is here! Jump higher with over 25 cats and customise your very own adorable collection!
description:
Dive into a world of jump arcade action brought to life by the most adorable and loveable illustrations imaginable! From the nimble Abyssinian to the fluffy Persian, the cheeky Munchkin, and the elegant Tuxedo cat, over 25 unique cat characters, each with their own special abilities and personality, are waiting for you across obstacle-filled stages. Endless stages that climb higher with every jump, extreme tension created by diverse obstacles and items, and an intuitive UI and controls optimised exclusively for this title deliver a fresh challenge every single time you play. With over 20 costumes to customise your perfect cat, this goes far beyond a simple arcade game; it is a fully realised collectible adventure!

・Over 25 unique cat characters, each with their own special ability!
・Over 20 costumes to create your very own cat!
・Endless stages that climb higher the more you jump!
・Upgrade your cat and use items to boost your jumping power!
・Casual arcade fun playable with just one hand!
・Addictive gameplay suitable for all ages!

A word of warning: once you start, you won't be able to stop! Higher, faster, stronger; push your limits! Whether you're a gamer after a quick burst of excitement, a cat lover who adores charming illustrations, or a family looking for fun together, Cat & Friends: Jumping Adventure delivers an unstoppable, one-of-a-kind jumping adventure!

Story
The owner who left for heaven first… One day, without warning, the Cat Friends were left alone in an empty house. The food bowl still there, the favourite toys still there, the blanket still warm with their owner's scent, yet their owner was nowhere to be found. Every day, the cats sat by the window and gazed up at the sky. Then one night, a faint voice drifted through the starlight.

"I miss you… I just want to hold you one more time…"

Their owner missed them too. No matter what obstacles lay ahead, no matter how high, even to the very ends of heaven, they would jump up and find their owner! Tripping, sliding, falling, the cats never give up. If it means seeing their owner again, they will get back up, again and again.

"Wait for us, dear owner. Your little cats are coming to find you, nyaa!"

Will the Cat Friends be reunited with their owner in heaven? The cats' heartfelt and passionate jumping journey to reach their beloved owner begins now!
